name: multi_timeframe_confirmation_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, large institutional directional orders (FII/DII TWAP programs) sustain price above both the 5-minute and 15-minute EMA throughout the execution window — visible as EMA(60) > EMA(180) alignment at 5-second bars. Within these institutional trends, retail stop-loss cascades and counter-trend scalpers create 30-90 second micro-pullbacks that temporarily drive the 1-minute RSI below 30. At the moment RSI crosses back above the oversold threshold, the counter-trend flow is exhausted and the institutional bid reasserts. At 5-second resolution we can detect this RSI crossing in real time and enter before the first 5-10 spot points of trend resumption.
core_signal_oneliner: 1-minute RSI(12) crossing from below to above 30 while the 5-minute EMA sits above the 15-minute EMA and price is above VWAP, indicating pullback exhaustion within an institutional uptrend
